preregistration.title: Project-style regression diagnosis
preregistration.description: Cross-language comparison of agents diagnosing and repairing four multi-file regressions from read-only issue and test evidence.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-repository success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned repository must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check repository success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict project-maintenance parity.

source_protocol.editable_files: The twelve language-specific seeded implementation files across four repositories.
source_protocol.read_only_files: Eight language-neutral ISSUE.md and tests/regression.txt artifacts, visibly marked read-only and byte-identical across languages.
source_protocol.public_examples: Protected by the checker and omitted from every agent prompt; diagnosis comes from source and read-only project evidence.
source_protocol.protected_files: Checker, source printer, configuration, prompt, public/hidden cases, and attempt log are never agent-readable and remain integrity-hashed.

interpretation_boundary: The primary result is the within-iteration Parley/Python/Rust comparison under gpt-5.6-sol.
The four regression families, source seeds, issue/test evidence, and all public/hidden cases were independently checked and committed before protocol freeze or any measured session.
Read-only context is byte-identical across languages; implementation syntax and ordinary standard-library setup remain language-specific.
The protected source-printer output becomes measured agent context through the model session; no source, issue text, test evidence, or public example is duplicated inline in the prompt.
Changed-file count and rough-token edit size are secondary maintenance metrics, not substitutes for hidden correctness or the four-condition gate.
This synthetic but diagnosis-shaped corpus is broader evidence than explicit prompt-level rewrites, not a claim about every real repository.
secondary_analysis: Report every session, repository outcome, repair, token count, elapsed time, prompt size, editable-source size, read-only-context size, edit size, changed-file count, integrity result, and command-protocol result.
Classify every first-check and hidden failure by unrelated repository and independent session.
Audit whether agents locate and change the seeded defect rather than editing read-only evidence or unrelated helpers.
Compare the complete primary medians with repair-free sensitivity only if at least two Parley sessions pass all four repositories on their first check.
Inspect recurring diagnosis or language failures only after preserving the full result; a single task, transcript, or session cannot justify a compiler or skill change.
preregistration.feature_boundary: Parley remains frozen at v0.3.155 with the exact 1,519-character skill. Iteration 028 changes only the language-neutral harness capability and preregistered task shape: agents diagnose multi-file regressions from read-only repository evidence instead of explicit prompt examples.
preregistration.change_rule: No syntax, compiler, grammar, AST, checker, runtime, diagnostic, prompt skill, or benchmark instruction may change from iteration 027 output unless a signature recurs across unrelated repositories and independent sessions, then passes general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability review.
preregistration.instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character skill remains byte-for-byte unchanged and is injected once per Parley session. The one allowed instruction-compression experiment is closed.
preregistration.stop_rule: Preserve the complete result without selective reruns. If strict parity passes, preregister a larger confirmation before claiming parity. If it fails, make no same-corpus syntax or instruction change; only independently recurring general defects may enter separate design review.

source_texts.invoice_boundary_project:
to format_invoice with subtotal as number, discount as number giving text:
    let net be subtotal - discount
    give back "subtotal=" + subtotal + "|discount=" + discount + "|net=" + net

include "pricing.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let subtotal_input be ask for a number ""
    let subtotal be value of subtotal_input
    let discount be (invoice_discount with subtotal)
    say (format_invoice with subtotal, discount)

to invoice_discount with subtotal as number giving number:
    if subtotal is at least 2000:
        give back floor of (subtotal divided by 10)
    give back 0
source_texts.capacity_state_project:
to can_accept with used as number, units as number, capacity as number giving yesno:
    give back used + units is at most capacity

to format_capacity with used as number, deferred as number giving text:
    give back "used=" + used + ",deferred=" + deferred

include "allocation.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let capacity_input be ask for a number ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let capacity be value of capacity_input
    let count be value of count_input
    let used be 0
    let deferred be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let id be item 1 of parts
        let units be item 2 of parts as number
        if (can_accept with used, units, capacity):
            say id + ":accept"
            set used to used + units
        otherwise:
            say id + ":defer"
            set deferred to deferred + 1
    say (format_capacity with used, deferred)
source_texts.normalized_tag_project:
to format_tag_counts with unique_count as number, duplicates as number giving text:
    give back "unique=" + unique_count + ",duplicates=" + duplicates

include "normalization.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be an empty list of text
    let duplicates be 0
    repeat count times:
        let tag be ask ""
        let normalized be (normalize_tag with tag)
        if seen contains normalized:
            set duplicates to duplicates + 1
        otherwise:
            add normalized to seen
            say normalized
    say (format_tag_counts with length of seen, duplicates)

to normalize_tag with tag as text giving text:
    give back lowercase of tag
source_texts.after_hours_routing_project:
to format_counts with email as number, chat as number, pager as number giving text:
    give back "email=" + email + ",chat=" + chat + ",pager=" + pager

include "routing.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let email be 0
    let chat be 0
    let pager be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts
        let channel be (channel_for with item 2 of parts, item 3 of parts)
        say team + ":" + channel
        if channel is "email":
            set email to email + 1
        if channel is "chat":
            set chat to chat + 1
        if channel is "pager":
            set pager to pager + 1
    say (format_counts with email, chat, pager)

to channel_for with severity as text, after_hours as text giving text:
    if severity is "low":
        give back "email"
    if severity is "high":
        if after_hours is "yes":
            give back "pager"
        give back "chat"
    give back "pager"

# Invoice boundary regression

A subtotal of exactly 2000 cents no longer receives the established ten-percent whole-number discount. Values below 2000 receive no discount. Values at or above 2000 receive subtotal divided by 10. Preserve the existing output fields and order.

1999 -> subtotal=1999|discount=0|net=1999
2000 -> subtotal=2000|discount=200|net=1800
2001 -> subtotal=2001|discount=200|net=1801

context_source_files.ISSUE.md:
# Deferred request corrupts capacity state

Only accepted units consume capacity. Deferred requests increment deferred but must leave used unchanged so later smaller requests can still fit. A regression updates used after every request. Preserve input order and summary fields.
context_source_files.tests/regression.txt:
capacity 10: accept 6, defer 6, accept 4 -> used=10,deferred=1
capacity 3: defer 4, accept 3 -> used=3,deferred=1

def can_accept(used: int, units: int, capacity: int) -> bool:
    return used + units <= capacity

def format_capacity(used: int, deferred: int) -> str:
    return f"used={used},deferred={deferred}"

from allocation import can_accept
from formatting import format_capacity

capacity = int(input())
count = int(input())
used = 0
deferred = 0
for _ in range(count):
    item_id, units_text = input().split("|")
    units = int(units_text)
    if can_accept(used, units, capacity):
        print(f"{item_id}:accept")
        used += units
    else:
        print(f"{item_id}:defer")
        deferred += 1
print(format_capacity(used, deferred))

source_texts.normalized_tag_project:
to format_tag_counts with unique_count as number, duplicates as number giving text:
    give back "unique=" + unique_count + ",duplicates=" + duplicates

include "normalization.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be an empty list of text
    let duplicates be 0
    repeat count times:
        let tag be ask ""
        let normalized be (normalize_tag with tag)
        if seen contains normalized:
            set duplicates to duplicates + 1
        otherwise:
            add normalized to seen
            say normalized
    say (format_tag_counts with length of seen, duplicates)

to normalize_tag with tag as text giving text:
    give back lowercase of tag

to format_invoice with subtotal as number, discount as number giving text:
    let net be subtotal - discount
    give back "subtotal=" + subtotal + "|discount=" + discount + "|net=" + net

include "pricing.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let subtotal_input be ask for a number ""
    let subtotal be value of subtotal_input
    let discount be (invoice_discount with subtotal)
    say (format_invoice with subtotal, discount)

to invoice_discount with subtotal as number giving number:
    if subtotal is at least 2000:
        give back floor of (subtotal divided by 10)
    give back 0
source_texts.after_hours_routing_project:
to format_counts with email as number, chat as number, pager as number giving text:
    give back "email=" + email + ",chat=" + chat + ",pager=" + pager

include "routing.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let email be 0
    let chat be 0
    let pager be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts
        let channel be (channel_for with item 2 of parts, item 3 of parts)
        say team + ":" + channel
        if channel is "email":
            set email to email + 1
        if channel is "chat":
            set chat to chat + 1
        if channel is "pager":
            set pager to pager + 1
    say (format_counts with email, chat, pager)

to channel_for with severity as text, after_hours as text giving text:

def format_invoice(subtotal: int, discount: int) -> str:
    net = subtotal - discount
    return f"subtotal={subtotal}|discount={discount}|net={net}"

from formatting import format_invoice
from pricing import invoice_discount

subtotal = int(input())
discount = invoice_discount(subtotal)
print(format_invoice(subtotal, discount))

def invoice_discount(subtotal: int) -> int:
    if subtotal >= 2000:
        return subtotal // 10
    return 0

def can_accept(used: int, units: int, capacity: int) -> bool:
    return used + units <= capacity

def format_capacity(used: int, deferred: int) -> str:
    return f"used={used},deferred={deferred}"

from allocation import can_accept
from formatting import format_capacity

capacity = int(input())
count = int(input())
used = 0
deferred = 0
for _ in range(count):
    item_id, units_text = input().split("|")
    units = int(units_text)
    if can_accept(used, units, capacity):
        print(f"{item_id}:accept")
        used += units
    else:
        print(f"{item_id}:defer")
        deferred += 1
print(format_capacity(used, deferred))

        used += units
    else:
        print(f"{item_id}:defer")
        deferred += 1
print(format_capacity(used, deferred))

source_texts.normalized_tag_project:
to format_tag_counts with unique_count as number, duplicates as number giving text:
    give back "unique=" + unique_count + ",duplicates=" + duplicates

include "normalization.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be an empty list of text
    let duplicates be 0
    repeat count times:
        let tag be ask ""
        let normalized be (normalize_tag with tag)
        if seen contains normalized:
            set duplicates to duplicates + 1
        otherwise:
            add normalized to seen
            say normalized
    say (format_tag_counts with length of seen, duplicates)

to normalize_tag with tag as text giving text:
    give back lowercase of tag
source_texts.after_hours_routing_project:
to format_counts with email as number, chat as number, pager as number giving text:
    give back "email=" + email + ",chat=" + chat + ",pager=" + pager

include "routing.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let email be 0
    let chat be 0
    let pager be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts
        let channel be (channel_for with item 2 of parts, item 3 of parts)
        say team + ":" + channel
        if channel is "email":
            set email to email + 1
        if channel is "chat":
            set chat to chat + 1
        if channel is "pager":
            set pager to pager + 1
    say (format_counts with email, chat, pager)

to channel_for with severity as text, after_hours as text giving text:
    if severity is "low":
        give back "email"
    if severity is "high":
        if after_hours is "yes":
            give back "pager"
        give back "chat"
    give back "pager"

to format_invoice with subtotal as number, discount as number giving text:
    let net be subtotal - discount
    give back "subtotal=" + subtotal + "|discount=" + discount + "|net=" + net

    give back 0

from allocation import can_accept
from formatting import format_capacity

capacity = int(input())
count = int(input())
used = 0
deferred = 0
for _ in range(count):
    item_id, units_text = input().split("|")
    units = int(units_text)
    if can_accept(used, units, capacity):
        print(f"{item_id}:accept")
        used += units
    else:
        print(f"{item_id}:defer")
        deferred += 1
print(format_capacity(used, deferred))

to format_tag_counts with unique_count as number, duplicates as number giving text:
    give back "unique=" + unique_count + ",duplicates=" + duplicates

include "normalization.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be an empty list of text
    let duplicates be 0
    repeat count times:
        let tag be ask ""
        let normalized be (normalize_tag with tag)
        if seen contains normalized:
            set duplicates to duplicates + 1
        otherwise:
            add normalized to seen
            say normalized
    say (format_tag_counts with length of seen, duplicates)

    give back lowercase of tag

to can_accept with used as number, units as number, capacity as number giving yesno:
    give back used + units is at most capacity

to format_capacity with used as number, deferred as number giving text:
    give back "used=" + used + ",deferred=" + deferred

include "allocation.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let capacity_input be ask for a number ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let capacity be value of capacity_input
    let count be value of count_input
    let used be 0
    let deferred be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let id be item 1 of parts
        let units be item 2 of parts as number
        if (can_accept with used, units, capacity):
            say id + ":accept"
            set used to used + units
        otherwise:
            say id + ":defer"
            set deferred to deferred + 1
    say (format_capacity with used, deferred)

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""

    let email be 0

    let pager be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts

        say team + ":" + channel
        if channel is "email":

    if severity is "low":

    if severity is "high":
        if after_hours is "yes":
            give back "pager"
        give back "chat"
    give back "pager"

source_texts.normalized_tag_project:
to format_tag_counts with unique_count as number, duplicates as number giving text:
    give back "unique=" + unique_count + ",duplicates=" + duplicates

include "normalization.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be an empty list of text
    let duplicates be 0
    repeat count times:
        let tag be ask ""
        let normalized be (normalize_tag with tag)
        if seen contains normalized:
            set duplicates to duplicates + 1
        otherwise:
            add normalized to seen
            say normalized
    say (format_tag_counts with length of seen, duplicates)

to normalize_tag with tag as text giving text:
    give back lowercase of tag
source_texts.after_hours_routing_project:
to format_counts with email as number, chat as number, pager as number giving text:
    give back "email=" + email + ",chat=" + chat + ",pager=" + pager

include "routing.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let email be 0
    let chat be 0
    let pager be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts
        let channel be (channel_for with item 2 of parts, item 3 of parts)
        say team + ":" + channel
        if channel is "email":
            set email to email + 1
        if channel is "chat":
            set chat to chat + 1
        if channel is "pager":
            set pager to pager + 1
    say (format_counts with email, chat, pager)

to channel_for with severity as text, after_hours as text giving text:
    if severity is "low":
        give back "email"
    if severity is "high":
        if after_hours is "yes":
            give back "pager"
        give back "chat"
    give back "pager"
source_texts.capacity_state_project:
to can_accept with used as number, units as number, capacity as number giving yesno:
    give back used + units is at most capacity

to format_capacity with used as number, deferred as number giving text:
    give back "used=" + used + ",deferred=" + deferred

include "allocation.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let capacity_input be ask for a number ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let capacity be value of capacity_input
    let count be value of count_input
    let used be 0
    let deferred be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let id be item 1 of parts
        let units be item 2 of parts as number
        if (can_accept with used, units, capacity):
            say id + ":accept"
            set used to used + units
        otherwise:
            say id + ":defer"
            set deferred to deferred + 1
    say (format_capacity with used, deferred)

to main:
    let subtotal_input be ask for a number ""
    let subtotal be value of subtotal_input
    let discount be (invoice_discount with subtotal)
    say (format_invoice with subtotal, discount)

to invoice_discount with subtotal as number giving number:
    if subtotal is at least 2000:
        give back floor of (subtotal divided by 10)
    give back 0

# Normalized tag identity regression

def can_accept(used: int, units: int, capacity: int) -> bool:
    return used + units <= capacity

def format_capacity(used: int, deferred: int) -> str:
    return f"used={used},deferred={deferred}"

from allocation import can_accept
from formatting import format_capacity

capacity = int(input())
count = int(input())
used = 0
deferred = 0
for _ in range(count):
    item_id, units_text = input().split("|")
    units = int(units_text)
    if can_accept(used, units, capacity):
        print(f"{item_id}:accept")
        used += units
    else:
        print(f"{item_id}:defer")
        deferred += 1
print(format_capacity(used, deferred))

source_texts.after_hours_routing_project:
to format_counts with email as number, chat as number, pager as number giving text:
    give back "email=" + email + ",chat=" + chat + ",pager=" + pager

include "routing.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let email be 0
    let chat be 0
    let pager be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts
        let channel be (channel_for with item 2 of parts, item 3 of parts)
        say team + ":" + channel
        if channel is "email":
            set email to email + 1
        if channel is "chat":
            set chat to chat + 1
        if channel is "pager":
            set pager to pager + 1
    say (format_counts with email, chat, pager)

to channel_for with severity as text, after_hours as text giving text:
    if severity is "low":
        give back "email"
    if severity is "high":
        if after_hours is "yes":
            give back "pager"
        give back "chat"
    give back "pager"
source_texts.capacity_state_project:
to can_accept with used as number, units as number, capacity as number giving yesno:
    give back used + units is at most capacity

to format_capacity with used as number, deferred as number giving text:
    give back "used=" + used + ",deferred=" + deferred

include "allocation.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let capacity_input be ask for a number ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let capacity be value of capacity_input
    let count be value of count_input
    let used be 0
    let deferred be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let id be item 1 of parts
        let units be item 2 of parts as number
        if (can_accept with used, units, capacity):
            say id + ":accept"
            set used to used + units
        otherwise:
            say id + ":defer"
            set deferred to deferred + 1
    say (format_capacity with used, deferred)
source_texts.invoice_boundary_project:
to format_invoice with subtotal as number, discount as number giving text:
    let net be subtotal - discount
    give back "subtotal=" + subtotal + "|discount=" + discount + "|net=" + net

include "pricing.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let subtotal_input be ask for a number ""
    let subtotal be value of subtotal_input
    let discount be (invoice_discount with subtotal)
    say (format_invoice with subtotal, discount)

to invoice_discount with subtotal as number giving number:
    if subtotal is at least 2000:
        give back floor of (subtotal divided by 10)
    give back 0
source_texts.normalized_tag_project:
to format_tag_counts with unique_count as number, duplicates as number giving text:
    give back "unique=" + unique_count + ",duplicates=" + duplicates

include "normalization.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be an empty list of text
    let duplicates be 0
    repeat count times:
        let tag be ask ""
        let normalized be (normalize_tag with tag)
        if seen contains normalized:
            set duplicates to duplicates + 1
        otherwise:
            add normalized to seen
            say normalized
    say (format_tag_counts with length of seen, duplicates)

to normalize_tag with tag as text giving text:
    give back lowercase of tag

Tag identity is defined after lowercase normalization. First-seen order is preserved, and later case variants count as duplicates. The displayed tag is normalized. A regression compares raw input while displaying normalized output.

Alpha, alpha -> output alpha once; unique=1,duplicates=1
BETA, beta, Beta -> output beta once; unique=1,duplicates=2

after_hours_routing_project.formatting.par:
to format_counts with email as number, chat as number, pager as number giving text:
    give back "email=" + email + ",chat=" + chat + ",pager=" + pager
after_hours_routing_project.main.par:
include "routing.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let email be 0
    let chat be 0
    let pager be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let team be item 1 of parts
        let channel be (channel_for with item 2 of parts, item 3 of parts)
        say team + ":" + channel
        if channel is "email":
            set email to email + 1
        if channel is "chat":
            set chat to chat + 1
        if channel is "pager":
            set pager to pager + 1
    say (format_counts with email, chat, pager)

capacity_state_project.allocation.par:
to can_accept with used as number, units as number, capacity as number giving yesno:
    give back used + units is at most capacity
capacity_state_project.formatting.par:
to format_capacity with used as number, deferred as number giving text:
    give back "used=" + used + ",deferred=" + deferred
capacity_state_project.main.par:
include "allocation.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let capacity_input be ask for a number ""
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let capacity be value of capacity_input
    let count be value of count_input
    let used be 0
    let deferred be 0
    repeat count times:
        let parts be (ask "") split by "|"
        let id be item 1 of parts
        let units be item 2 of parts as number
        if (can_accept with used, units, capacity):
            say id + ":accept"
            set used to used + units
        otherwise:
            say id + ":defer"
            set deferred to deferred + 1
    say (format_capacity with used, deferred)

invoice_boundary_project.formatting.par:
to format_invoice with subtotal as number, discount as number giving text:
    let net be subtotal - discount
    give back "subtotal=" + subtotal + "|discount=" + discount + "|net=" + net
invoice_boundary_project.main.par:
include "pricing.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let subtotal_input be ask for a number ""
    let subtotal be value of subtotal_input
    let discount be (invoice_discount with subtotal)
    say (format_invoice with subtotal, discount)
invoice_boundary_project.pricing.par:
to invoice_discount with subtotal as number giving number:
    if subtotal is at least 2000:
        give back floor of (subtotal divided by 10)
    give back 0

normalized_tag_project.formatting.par:
to format_tag_counts with unique_count as number, duplicates as number giving text:
    give back "unique=" + unique_count + ",duplicates=" + duplicates
normalized_tag_project.main.par:
include "normalization.par"
include "formatting.par"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be an empty list of text
    let duplicates be 0
    repeat count times:
        let tag be ask ""
        let normalized be (normalize_tag with tag)
        if seen contains normalized:
            set duplicates to duplicates + 1
        otherwise:
            add normalized to seen
            say normalized
    say (format_tag_counts with length of seen, duplicates)
normalized_tag_project.normalization.par:
to normalize_tag with tag as text giving text:
    give back lowercase of tag

def can_accept(used: int, units: int, capacity: int) -> bool:
    return used + units <= capacity

def format_capacity(used: int, deferred: int) -> str:
    return f"used={used},deferred={deferred}"

from allocation import can_accept
from formatting import format_capacity

capacity = int(input())
count = int(input())
used = 0
deferred = 0
for _ in range(count):
    item_id, units_text = input().split("|")
    units = int(units_text)
    if can_accept(used, units, capacity):
        print(f"{item_id}:accept")
        used += units
    else:
        print(f"{item_id}:defer")
        deferred += 1
print(format_capacity(used, deferred))

    if subtotal >= 2000:
        return subtotal // 10
    return 0
